title: Launch Monitor Ball Speed Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Golf rounds (`golf:round`), Garmin golf telemetry (`garmin:golf`), UDisc rounds (`udisc:round`), launch-monitor shots (`launchmonitor:shot`), handicap-index updates (`handicap:index`).
app: Arccos and Garmin S62 round telemetry, UDisc round exports, launch-monitor CSVs, and handicap-index updates streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=launchmonitor:shot
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(ball_speed_mph) as total_value avg(carry_yards) as avg_duration count as sessions by _time
| sort - _time
description: Summarizes launch monitor ball speed by month so you can review season-to-date volume without digging through individual sessions.
value: A monthly rollup is useful for spotting big directional changes and for keeping a simple log of a long season.
implementation: Retain at least a season of history so month-over-month comparisons stay meaningful.
visualization: Column chart of monthly totals with average session duration overlaid.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates the bigger month-by-month picture for launch monitor ball speed instead of one session at a time.
